items.title: Paramount, Warner Bros. Discovery expect merger to close Oct 6
items.summary: Investing.com-- Paramount Skydance (NASDAQ:PSKY) and Warner Bros Discovery (NASDAQ:WBD) said on Wednesday they expect their merger to close on Oct. 6, bringing the two U.S. media companies closer to combining their entertainment and streaming businesses.

items.title: Paramount Settlement of Antitrust Case Approved by Judge
items.summary: The deal announced last week with 12 states, led by California, clears the way for the company’s $81-billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery.

items.title: Mattel’s Ynon Kreiz Named Co-CEO at Paramount-Warner
items.summary: He will be heavily involved in the day-to-day management as well as strategic planning and the integration of the combined businesses.

items.title: Paramount Bonds Yield 9% Ahead of Massive Debt Sale. Is It Time to Buy?
items.summary: Paramount Skydance is selling about $52 billion of debt to finance its $81 billion cash purchase of Warner Bros. Discovery.

items.title: PSKY's High-Grade Bond Offering To Fund Warner Takeover Tops $109B Ahead Of Wednesday Pricing: Report
items.summary: Books closed Tuesday afternoon at about 3.6 times the amount expected to be sold after lenders moved part of the funding into loans, Bloomberg reported.

items.title: Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) Stock May Have More Room Following Merger Clearance
items.summary: Warner Bros. Discovery has been on a powerful run in recent years, and the stock now sits at a point where investors are asking whether that share price is properly backed by the cash the business can produce. With a pending merger with Paramount Skydance reshaping the media group on paper, the question is how much of the current valuation really connects to Warner Bros. Discovery's underlying cash flows. items.title: Bond Yields Keep Rising Despite Drop in Oil Price, Dovish Fed Speech
items.summary: The long-term Treasury bond yield touches a 24-year high, while the New York Fed’s president says there was “no need for urgency” in raising interest rates.

items.title: Paramount Jumbo Bond Sale Adds to Pressure on Treasurys
items.summary: Paramount Skydance is working to issue $32 billion of investment-grade bonds to help fund its acquisition of Warner Bros., a huge slug of debt that investors said was contributing to weakness in longer-term U.S. Treasurys.
